components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One primary action per view. Night on Sunset Orange in the dark, cream on Low Sun in the light.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--fx-primary); color: var(--fx-on-primary); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--fx-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fx-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The email and other secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--fx-border-strong); background: transparent; color: var(--fx-text); text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--fx-surface); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fx-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav link
components.description: Mono caps. The current section carries a 2px primary underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: var(--fx-font-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fx-text-muted); text-decoration: none; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-nav[aria-current='true'] { color: var(--fx-primary-text); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--fx-primary); }

components.name: Record plate
components.description: Graphite in the dark, paper in the light, border only or the light card shadow.
components.css: .ds-plate { background: var(--fx-surface); color: var(--fx-text); border: 1px solid var(--fx-border); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--fx-shadow-card); padding: 24px; }

narrative.overview: The site is a night studio that switches to coast light. Night is the ground, Graphite holds the record, and Sunset Orange appears as the signature. Cream mode swaps the ground to Adobe Cream and the accent to Low Sun.
keyCharacteristics: Archivo 800 display, width axis 112, tracking no tighter than -0.04em.
Inter for reading. JetBrains Mono for labels, codes, and data keys.
One primary action per view. Night type on orange. Low Sun text on cream.
Borders in the dark. A soft offset shadow only in the light.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sunset Orange is not text and not a fill behind text on cream. Lavender and Lawn Teal stay out of the UI. One orange glow, on the hero primary action, and only in the dark theme.

dos: Do keep Night on orange and Low Sun on cream.
Do use the outlined wordmark and the cream clay avatar.
Do put new colors in src/styles/tokens.css only.
donts: Don't put Sunset Orange on cream.
Don't put Paper or white on Sunset Orange.
Don't bring back the blue accent, the terminal prompt, or a glass header.
